name: splitsutra
description: SplitSutra — square up, no awkwardness. Expense-sharing app on Firebase.

scripts.//typecheck: firebase/seed is not a workspace package, so `pnpm -r` never reached it and nothing typechecked 2k lines of script that builds money records. typecheck:seed builds core first because firebase/seed/src/dataset.ts imports packages/core/dist by relative path and tsc needs the .d.ts files that only the build emits — same reason, and same fix, as firebase/functions declaring build:core rather than trusting topological ordering.
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r --if-present typecheck && pnpm typecheck:seed && pnpm typecheck:tests
scripts.test: pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:rules && pnpm test:integration
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-rules "vitest run --project rules"
scripts.test:integration: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth,functions --project demo-integration "vitest run --project integration"
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm depcruise && pnpm test:unit
